about_the_game:
This official soundtrack is for those who wish to support the continued development of Akane’s Way: Katakana and Akane’s Way: Kanji.

It includes:

  • 🎵 The Intro Theme

  • 🎵 The Main Menu Theme

  • 🎵 The Credits Song

  • 🎵 10 Shamisen-style learning tracks used in Harmony Mode

This is a thank-you gift for those who believe in the project and want to help it grow. It is not a required purchase. The full game is already free.

100% of all proceeds from this soundtrack go toward the development of future titles including hiring artists, commissioning voice performances, and supporting collaborators. None of the revenue will be used to compensate the developer’s time.

Thank you for walking this path with us. Every small donation helps bring the next step closer.
